newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo tests three-month highs against mark.
newsitem.headline: Escudo tests three-month highs against mark.

text.p: The escudo was at three-month highs against the mark on Thursday, testing the psychological barrier of 100 to the German currency.
Traders said that the barrier could even be broken later in the session for the first time since mid-January with the market betting on the Bank of Portugal cutting interest rates on Friday.
The currency was at 100.09/12 at 1500 GMT, having touched a high of 100.02, compared with its 100.23/33 opening.

"The figure (100.00 escudos per mark) is now the objective and if there is a fresh push it is going to happen," said one trader. Traders said that non-residents had been active buyers of the Portuguese currency.
